paper_reason: Papyan, Han & Donoho (PNAS 2020) is a phenomenology paper: its NC1-NC4 figures are decay curves over training epochs for supervised vision networks. It publishes no NC1 or NC2 value for a pretrained language model's mean-pooled hidden states under an ad-hoc 5-topic label set, and no value could transfer. This is a genuine NONE. The analytic anchors all hold: Sigma_B has rank exactly K-1; NC1 = 1.874e-33 at zero within-class spread; on exact simplex-ETF class means equinorm_cv = 8.600e-17, etf_dev = 5.000e-13 and cosine_std = 9.774e-17; on orthonormal centres (an ETF after centring) etf_dev = 0.0000 and cosine_std = 3.511e-17.
